data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=uxFsr6yAlHsQ7kNvgGLOJjh&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBFjOkr3iyNn8hcG8QLuYalpaWj0-shINNJpix149mKQQ&oe=675C1B1C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_X95h914QnkQ7kNvgFW0h1F&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCHUMRoERw3a4CdaAQG8HREBy8TgWBVgHjdKC4aPaveZA&oe=675C24A4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NtoANQcVgowQ7kNvgF7aohz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA-vzHvsHGc6OWRtDup0_n8mII-vsN6T3pAZxuNm6H_Gg&oe=675C0C07)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=N7TYZ8QDqjsQ7kNvgEP1cFL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCvrKd4kWt4HgYhM813HSznWm4nHiM4Fd2TAlRUHpC2-A&oe=675BFEE6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=eRPg4bSELtkQ7kNvgEPLhgx&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDXEuqzYhCK56AD2i2ljf5IH26m9_AiibRTuf-i_7_kUA&oe=675C2B58)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=6CWXGVQl5UEQ7kNvgGjOpFX&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDZTYUqLd0VVirfS9jYrrnLwxCjwNb831GUmDN-mjxfIA&oe=675C27D9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oCXjTmTzfFwQ7kNvgE2wzeD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBbid0_hAdzEKE3elFqGIifELx7UTTVBDQrDGpuNLcEMg&oe=675C0DF0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=Kat4xLb0ePkQ7kNvgGZtD_H&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBVQx9NIzVbEc561GvsxTb41K2TFkeIorQkFbhADtYfXQ&oe=675C30AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=c-U4N54m80EQ7kNvgFiw-OS&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCY1vpomo286s2hoLhsdWwJHVlc5-7M_EK2w_PXjvuKIw&oe=675C0C17)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=fEKNwXd54RcQ7kNvgGlNU35&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCXQb6yz4mLe6su2JbFSlolOtPKMzskmB2-JA8nPHeO2A&oe=675C278C)
